entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider acts as a universal memory layer supporting multi-level states for Users, Sessions, and Agents. It offers temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval through an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and hybrid RAG search. It maintains user profiles through automated fact extraction and provides connectors for services like Google Drive, Gmail, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This official Hermes Agent memory provider utilizes the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing and tiered L0/L1/L2 data loading. It is an AGPL-3.0 open-source context database designed to improve task-completion rates.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for the Hermes Agent provides synthesized answers accompanied by citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without requiring LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system facilitates long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents and is accessible via Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library for building stateful agents supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that treats memory as a git repo using brv vc commit, branch, and merge versioning. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency memory system utilizes a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance. It supports direct memory operations via a Python SDK and MCP via stdio or SSE.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context. It combines vector search and structured facts using local infrastructure like Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive context harness provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets to assist agents with complex tasks. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for task investigation.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This lossless context management plugin uses a DAG-based engine and a SQLite message store with FTS metadata. It builds depth-aware summary nodes to ensure no message is lost during agent interactions.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for the Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This project provides a shared memory layer for multi-agent systems using an open engram YAML format. It supports Hermes and offers local-first, zero-cost search by storing memory as plain-text YAML engram files.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This layer provides local-first identity, memory, and secrets for AI agents, enabling portable state across Hermes Agent and other clients. It includes specific tools for memory inspection, editing, and deletion and reports a 97.6% average LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device memory and context engine operates fully locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval via BM25 and vector search to support Hermes agents.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% in tokens, featuring native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This is a durable, file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of a vector database. It is offered as a five-package plugin family including a Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin is embedded by default and provides explainable retrieval via a why_retrieved tag. It features automated memory hygiene, consolidation, and self-directing memory loops for knowledge gaps.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It utilizes local-first storage via SQLite-vec and GGUF models and functions as an MCP-native server.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with a purpose-built evidence packet per query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking and keyword selection. It includes a dashboard to track estimated savings in tool-schema tokens.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This memory and context layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only the necessary context. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and is local-first with no account required.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This project provides long-term, cross-project memory by storing data as inspectable Markdown files. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and allows users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database and BM25-first retrieval. It features an importance ranking system from 1-10 to prioritize high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory with an on-demand summarizer and real deletion capabilities. It includes a trace.jsonl audit log to track every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables APIs to charge for themselves using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates directly with Hermes to facilitate agent payments.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-mode execution. It features HNSW, sparse, FM-index, and bitmap indexing for diverse recall methods.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing through five native tools for searching and reporting on artifacts. It supports indexing for scripts, markdown documents, cron jobs, MCP servers, and skills.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider uses hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods across 17 management tools. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This local plugin enables private code memory for repositories through semantic and literal code search. It supports grounded Q&A that provides specific file-and-line citations.

entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution for shared user teams through an Agentic Evolver. It provides unified skill libraries across devices and automates quality improvement and deduplication.

entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A suite of skills for extracting transcripts, captions, and timestamps without yt-dlp. It supports video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other compatible tools.

entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running agents through a three-level work model and structured memory using file-backed or SQLite-backed cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
